task: GitHub issue #9: effectful commands — edit, test, review with idempotency keys

acceptance.criterion: edit, test and review CommandSpecs registered with complete contracts in the existing spec style; edit uses a durable-write class (IRREVERSIBLE_WRITE already in the enum, no new value needed) with a non-placeholder compensation note; test and review are READ_ONLY
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_registry.py parametrized EFFECTFUL_COMMANDS contract/presence/effect-class/input-shape tests plus test_edit_compensation_is_not_a_placeholder all pass; catalog grew to 20 sorted names.

acceptance.criterion: Every INVOCATION_DISPATCHED payload carries idempotency_key == f"{run_id}:{invocation_id}", on success and failure paths alike
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_coordinator.py: test_every_dispatched_payload_carries_the_idempotency_key, test_idempotency_key_uses_the_explicit_run_id, test_failed_invocation_still_dispatched_with_idempotency_key; tests/test_effectful.py asserts the keys on a real CLI run's three dispatched events.

acceptance.criterion: WorkspacePolicy: workspace_root constructor param on SequentialCoordinator; effectful (durable-write, registry-resolved) dispatches inject _workspace_root into the resolved args and the DISPATCHED payload; None means no injection and dispatch is unchanged
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_coordinator.py: test_workspace_root_injected_only_for_effectful_commands (edit gets the root, define does not) and test_no_workspace_root_means_no_injection; CLI run events show _workspace_root only on the edit dispatch.

acceptance.criterion: CLI handlers: edit writes under the workspace root refusing absolute paths and .. escapes before any bytes are written; test runs python3 -m pytest -q with a timeout returning {exit_code, tail<=40 lines}; review returns the artifact refs; --workspace argument added to tikhon run defaulting to the db's directory
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_effectful.py end-to-end (edit→test→review run succeeds with DONE OUT.exit_code == 0; run without --workspace writes next to events.db; test handler returns exit_code 0/1 with bounded tail; review returns refs) all pass.

acceptance.criterion: Traversal attempts fail the run coherently: FAILED + RUN_FINISHED, no partial state, following steps cancelled, nothing written inside or outside the workspace
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_effectful.py::test_edit_traversal_fails_the_run_coherently (absolute-path and dotdot-escape) and test_traversal_failure_cancels_following_steps pass: zero committed state nodes, all ledger tasks cancelled, escaped file never created.

acceptance.criterion: Path-traversal security unit-tested directly against the handler
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_effectful.py: test_edit_handler_rejects_traversal_paths (six shapes incl. nested a/../../ and symlink-realpath escapes via _resolve_workspace_path), test_edit_handler_rejects_malformed_inputs, test_edit_handler_requires_a_workspace_root, test_test_handler_rejects_traversal_paths all pass with an empty workspace asserted after each refusal.
python3 -m pytest -q: 363 passed (baseline 314 before edits; +49 new or extended tests).

acceptance.criterion: Tikhon protocol honored: program.think sealed before source edits and never modified afterwards; WORKLOG.md maintained; scratch program linted and executed through the real CLI
acceptance.evidence: seal.txt (b37f564cdf29fff23e88b7f57559fc05b871c15c3e78894a764b7f0c1010a970) written before the first source edit; recomputed digest after all edits matches; scratch-edit-test-review.think lints valid and its CLI run prints succeeded/100% with tikhon audit OK.

Changes confined to src/tikhon/registry/builtins.py, src/tikhon/runtime/coordinator.py, src/tikhon/cli.py, tests/test_registry.py, tests/test_coordinator.py, tests/test_effectful.py (new), and demo/runs/issue-09-effectful-commands/; syntax/, events.py, tasks.py, audit.py, other demo runs, .opencode/, docs/ untouched (git status attributes the syntax/ diffs to the concurrent issue-12 agent).

protocol_deviations: The issue offered REVERSIBLE_WRITE-or-IRREVERSIBLE for edit; enums.py already declared IRREVERSIBLE_WRITE, so the stronger and more accurate class was chosen with the required compensation note ('restore the previous file content from the pre-write backup; a refused path leaves nothing to compensate').

The coordinator still dispatches effectful commands when workspace_root is None (per the issue: edit-style commands still work, no root provided), but the CLI edit/test handlers treat an undeclared workspace as a precondition failure; tikhon run always declares a root (default: the --db directory), so CLI behavior is unaffected.
The test handler invokes sys.executable -m pytest instead of the literal python3 token so the run's interpreter (e.g. inside a venv) executes the suite; identical behavior in this environment.

Bare python3 -m tikhon resolves to a stale site-packages copy rather than src/ (pytest uses pythonpath=src); live CLI evidence was therefore produced with PYTHONPATH=src. No repo change was needed or made.
Issue #12 ran concurrently on src/tikhon/syntax/; no edits were made in that tree and the combined suite is green.
